text: Employer: Lim Household, Singapore. Employee: Siti Rahma, Indonesia.
Duration: 24 months from the date the work permit is issued.
Salary: SGD 700 a month, the amount declared in the work permit application, paid no later than 7 days after the last day of each month, into the employee's bank account if she asks.

Rest days: one rest day in every week, on a day both parties agree. If the employee agrees in writing to work on a rest day, the employer pays her one extra day's salary for it or gives a replacement rest day in the same month.
Daily rest: the employee has at least 8 continuous hours of rest every day.
Documents: the employee keeps her own passport and work permit at all times.
Deductions: the employer makes no deduction from the salary except those allowed by law and agreed by the employee in writing.
Fees: the employer does not ask for or receive any payment from the employee in connection with her employment.
Accommodation: a private room with a bed, mattress, pillow, blanket, a fan and good ventilation, at the address in the work permit.
Medical: the employer buys and keeps medical insurance for the employee and pays for her medical treatment.
Annual leave: 7 days of paid leave for each year of service.
End of contract: the employer pays the air ticket home and sends the employee home within 2 weeks of the end of the contract.
Signed: Lim Ah Kow (Employer)   Siti Rahma (Employee)   Date: 1 September 2026
